summary.purpose: P1 playtest item: the red-army turn-20 survival victory (turn > 20) was only checked at the START of _end_turn, so when round 20 completed and the turn counter rolled to 21, no declaration fired — the game silently drew a round-21 event and only declared after the next player ended their turn. _end_turn now runs _check_victory immediately after the round rollover increments the turn, declaring the winner (and A4 co-winners via the same path) at the exact moment round 20 completes, without drawing a round-21 event. Victory-screen display remains a P1 UI item.
